label: Proposed/Recommended475; settled user direction and chosen engineering decisions

rows.subject: One remote stack
rows.falsifier: Source-backed chosen stack cannot meet qualified recovery/budget constraints.
rows.context: Accepted jobs must outlive clients and work across users/hosts.
considered_options: Local embedded product plus later hosted rewrite
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Adds operational components and maintenance; avoids two durability architectures.
rows.revisit_trigger: Source-backed chosen stack cannot meet qualified recovery/budget constraints.

rows.subject: Gin adapter
rows.decision: Gin with strict schema/error/proxy/context policy; domain uses context.Context.
rows.supersedes: Standard library/Chi viable, no unsupported inferiority claim.
rows.falsifier: Strict boundary or maintainability tests cannot be satisfied without disproportionate patching.
rows.context: 473 used standard HTTP simplicity without deep Gin study.
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Framework context/binding defaults need explicit adaptation; cohesive route tooling is the benefit.
rows.revisit_trigger: Strict boundary or maintainability tests cannot be satisfied without disproportionate patching.

rows.subject: PG application truth
rows.decision: pm_app owns accepted intent, effects, grants, manifests and events.
rows.supersedes: Temporal owns orchestration, not provider effect facts.
rows.falsifier: Cross-store recovery loses accepted work/effect identity.
rows.context: Two durable systems can disagree after either handoff reply is lost.
considered_options: PG app truth plus Temporal orchestration
Temporal history as all business state
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Outbox/reconciler complexity is necessary; no cross-system atomicity claim.
rows.revisit_trigger: Cross-store recovery loses accepted work/effect identity.

rows.subject: Tenant authority
rows.decision: Application authorization plus scoped RLS/non-owner roles and explicit workspace.
rows.supersedes: No global current-workspace or app-only filter dependence.
rows.falsifier: Any cross-resource/pool-reuse negative case leaks or mutates foreign scope.
rows.context: Multiple workspaces and pooled connections make missing filters consequential.
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Policies/roles/transaction cleanup add complexity and do not protect against fully compromised trusted PG credentials.
rows.revisit_trigger: Any cross-resource/pool-reuse negative case leaks or mutates foreign scope.

rows.subject: Durable grant
rows.decision: Session checked at API acceptance; independent run grant checked at effect boundaries.
rows.supersedes: Logout/expiry does not cancel accepted work.
rows.falsifier: Expiry stops accepted job or explicit grant revocation permits a new mutation.
rows.first_milestone: M1 contract, M4 admission; M9 explicit control integration
rows.context: Short login sessions and long accepted jobs have different lifetimes.
considered_options: Recheck original login session every send
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Requires explicit grant revocation/expiry and reconciliation-only authority, but ordinary logout is safe.
rows.revisit_trigger: Expiry stops accepted job or explicit grant revocation permits a new mutation.

rows.subject: Provider I/O ownership
rows.decision: All provider requests/discovery run in admitted worker activities.
rows.supersedes: API inline reads are PM metadata only; admin encrypts ingress only.
rows.falsifier: API obtains provider signer/executes request outside admitted worker path.
rows.context: Inline provider execution could create another signer/rate/receipt path.
considered_options: Bounded API provider execution with same guards
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Direct reads incur durable admission latency; one execution path is easier to audit.
rows.revisit_trigger: API obtains provider signer/executes request outside admitted worker path.

rows.subject: Source fidelity
rows.decision: One pinned source/ref closure -> typed operations -> generated safe projections.
rows.supersedes: No generated provider-specific Go SDK or source/proof runtime reader.
rows.falsifier: Null/media/status/location/requiredness changes without valid source rule.
rows.context: Historical projected schemas invented nullability and discarded response variants.
considered_options: Pinned typed compiler with sparse amendments
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Compiler fidelity requires real fixtures and explicit unsupported shapes; generated code remains disposable.
rows.revisit_trigger: Null/media/status/location/requiredness changes without valid source rule.

rows.subject: Actual capability registry
rows.decision: One executable composition with real activity consumers; compiler/value/proof foundations compose at their actual owners.
rows.supersedes: Atlas and descriptors alone cannot claim implementation.
rows.falsifier: Removing actual handler leaves capability reported implemented.
rows.context: Historical helper libraries/descriptors lacked product consumers.
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Requires end-to-end reachability and phase wiring tests; avoids false implementation claims.
rows.revisit_trigger: Removing actual handler leaves capability reported implemented.

rows.subject: Member effect truth
rows.decision: Persist dispatch/member intent and capacity before I/O, settle exact correlated outcomes.
rows.supersedes: Aggregate counts or workflow success are insufficient.
rows.falsifier: Response loss/retry creates duplicate or erases unknown effect.
rows.context: Batch transport and member outcomes are different; response loss is ambiguous.
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: More state and readback cost; preserves partial success and honest unknowns.
rows.revisit_trigger: Response loss/retry creates duplicate or erases unknown effect.

rows.subject: Temporal schedules
rows.decision: Temporal trigger owns occurrence; effect-free scheduled workflow first admits then adopts same execution.
rows.supersedes: No short launcher breaking overlap, duplicate StartRun or PM cron.
rows.falsifier: Concurrent mutation/trigger/DST/overlap case admits duplicate or wrong occurrence.
rows.context: Calendar semantics, overlap and out-of-order edits are provider-specific to the scheduler.
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Low-level CAS adapter and occurrence admission add code; no competing scheduler.
rows.revisit_trigger: Concurrent mutation/trigger/DST/overlap case admits duplicate or wrong occurrence.

rows.subject: Immutable shared bytes
rows.decision: Unique S3 attempt objects then PG manifest/checkpoint commit.
rows.supersedes: No host rename or conditional-PUT atomicity assumption.
rows.falsifier: Partial/corrupt bytes publish or a second host cannot read registered data.
rows.context: Multiple worker hosts cannot use one host rename as byte publication truth.
considered_options: S3 immutable attempts plus PG manifest
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Object service plus orphan/GC/integrity handling; portable bytes and bounded control DB.
rows.revisit_trigger: Partial/corrupt bytes publish or a second host cannot read registered data.

rows.subject: Analytical child
rows.decision: Only restricted pm-query/analytics links DuckDB native driver.
rows.supersedes: No shared writable native file or arbitrary SQL security assumption.
rows.context: Untrusted analytical data/query bounds need an actual process boundary.
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Native helper packaging and scratch copying cost; contains query failures/secrets.

rows.subject: Public client parity
rows.decision: One OpenAPI3.1 Go/browser contract; separate admin ingress and route-specific auth.
rows.supersedes: Full UI deferred; browser harness real, not Node-only cookie proof.
rows.falsifier: Equivalent use cases differ in permissions, inputs, effects or errors.
rows.context: Future UI must exercise the same product use cases as CLI.
considered_options: One public OpenAPI3.1 with two clients
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Requires actual-browser auth tests and constrained generator schemas; no full UI now.
rows.revisit_trigger: Equivalent use cases differ in permissions, inputs, effects or errors.

rows.subject: Durable events
rows.decision: Per-run locked sequence with state/event TX and scoped snapshot/gap replay.
rows.supersedes: Global sequence allocation or live bus is not commit-order durability.
rows.falsifier: Delayed first transaction causes reconnect cursor to skip committed event.
rows.context: SSE reconnect cannot infer commit order from ID allocation or live notifications.
considered_options: Per-run locked sequence and PG replay
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Run-row serialization and retention snapshots cost writes; prevents skipped late commits.
rows.revisit_trigger: Delayed first transaction causes reconnect cursor to skip committed event.

rows.subject: Operator lifecycle and recovery
rows.decision: Explicit full stack launcher, ownership-aware schema/init, quarantine restore and data retention.
rows.supersedes: No CLI autostart, managed-service mutation or implicit purge.
rows.falsifier: Upgrade/restore reissues uncertain external effect or loses required state.
rows.context: Operator must know which services/data PM owns and what restore can safely resume.
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Coordinated maintenance/backup drills are required; one-host is not HA.
rows.revisit_trigger: Upgrade/restore reissues uncertain external effect or loses required state.

rows.subject: Proof scope
rows.supersedes: No batch authority, stale pass resurrection or inherited certification.
rows.falsifier: Wrong effect/bytes/rows or invalidated old pass appears certified.
rows.context: New binaries cannot inherit old connector proof counts.
considered_options: Exact case receipts and independent oracles
rows.tradeoffs_and_consequences: Live validation can be tier/account blocked; valid independent passes are preserved with provenance.
rows.revisit_trigger: Wrong effect/bytes/rows or invalidated old pass appears certified.
